newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Rebels 65 km from Kinshasa airport -mine company.
newsitem.headline: Rebels 65 km from Kinshasa airport -mine company.

text.p: Zairean rebels have pushed to within 40 miles (65 km) of the main airport in the capital Kinshasa, a mining manager said on Sunday, quoting company reports from the capital.
On a separate front to the southwest of Kinshasa, the rebels have captured the town of Mbanza-Ngungu, he added.

"The rebels are now only 40 miles from the airport on the way from Kikwit. We have been able to detect their movements and they are now pushing past the 40-mile range," said the manager, who asked not to be named.
Kikwit has been one of the marshalling points on the main front approaching the capital from the southeast. Kinshasa airport is to the east of the city centre.
On Saturday rebel commanders said their frontline forces were about 150 km (95 miles) from Kinshasa on this front.

The rebels, from the Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire, say they will enter the city if President Mobutu Sese Seko does not cede power to rebel leader Laurent Kabila at talks on a South African ship on Sunday.
